label: Currency and deposits
basis: Eurostat F.2, consolidated; the État's own account at the Banque de France is €23bn (CGE) — the rest is social-security and local cash
note: Run down to a €30bn operating floor. INSEE: cash fell €19.9bn in 2025 already.

label: Debt securities held
basis: Eurostat F.3, market value; mostly the social-security reserve funds' bond portfolios
note: Saleable at market; the reserves belong to the pension schemes, not the État.

label: Loans granted
basis: Eurostat F.4; loans to foreign states, students, public bodies, the EU recovery vehicles
note: Securitisable at a discount; counted half in the realistic run, whole in the maximal one.

label: Listed equity (APE portfolio)
basis: APE, market value at 30 June 2025: Airbus, Safran, Thales, Engie, Orange, Renault, Eramet, FDJ, Air France-KLM, ADP
note: Every listed line sold, strategic or not: the 2027 programmes all touch some of these.

label: Investment fund shares
basis: Eurostat F.52, market value; the FRR, AGIRC-ARRCO, CNAV and ODAC placements
note: Half in the realistic run (the reserves of the complementary schemes are the social partners'); all in the maximal.

label: Unlisted and other equity
basis: Eurostat F.51 less the listed lines; EDF, SNCF, La Poste, RATP, Bpifrance, the CDC and the Banque de France at own funds
note: Minority stakes (EDF, La Poste, RATP, SNCF subsidiaries) €100bn in the realistic run; the whole book value in the maximal — a value no buyer would pay.

label: Caisse des dépôts own funds
basis: CDC aggregated own funds, end-2025; CDC is a financial corporation (S.12) under Parliament's protection, its contribution to the État €3.3bn in 2025
note: An exceptional transfer of half its own funds in the extreme run; the État's claim is partly inside F.51 already, so this may double count.

label: Banque de France gold
basis: 2,437 tonnes at end-2025 book value; realised gains flow to the Banque's result, then to the État as dividend
note: Half the stock in the extreme run only: an NCB's gold operations need the ECB's assent (Statute art. 31) and the proceeds are the Banque's, not the Trésor's.

label: Non-financial assets
basis: Eurostat nama_10_nfa_bs: produced assets (roads, schools, hospitals, military) and land at replacement cost
note: Not counted in any run: the État sells well under €1bn of real estate a year and the rest is the public service itself.
